newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nintendo surges on expected price cut.
newsitem.headline: Nintendo surges on expected price cut.

text.p: Nintendo Co Ltd shares surged on Tuesday morning due to expectations that the video-game maker will cut the price of its 64-bit game machine, brokers said.
As of 0042 GMT, the shares were 100 yen higher at 8,980.
A Japanese daily reported late last week that Nintendo plans to cut the price of the video game machine in the United States to about $150 from a current $199.
A Nintendo official told Reuters on Monday that its U.S. unit was responsible for its game-machine business in the United States and that he could not comment on whether the price would be reduced.
He added that the U.S. unit had not announced any cut in the price of the 64-bit machine.
